notes: FB12 (kind: sold product). Verified on the supplier page 2026-11-25: 120x65x38, 40 kg, flat-packed, 'זמין במלאי', 12-month warranty, price 5,000 ILS (natural, bleached and smoked are 5,000; walnut brown 5,600). Top thickness and leg section are NOT stated; from the photos the top looks about 3-4 cm, to be confirmed from the SKU. Photos: image 1 is a studio packshot that looks CGI-rendered (3/4 view, straight-on not available); images 2 and 3 are real photos of a unit in a home (3/4 view, and a close-up of the waterfall edge with end grain). No straight side view of a real unit. Finishes by name: Solid Bleached oak (J-OF120-W), Solid Oak (J-OF120-N), Smoked oak (J-OF120-C, photographed dark brown, L* about 25-30, rejected for colour), Walnut brown (J-OF120-B, dark, rejected for colour). Only 'Solid Oak' (natural) is in range. Estimated L* of natural: about 62-66 (packshot ~#C9A06E, real photo ~#B88C5C; estimate by eye, no spectro), S about 30; at the top of the L* 56-66 range, check against the real-photo unit. Length 120 is borderline (A.3: 120-129; ratio 0.55 against a 220 sofa), the owner's lighter-look test is in-frame. Shape is a rectangle with rounded corners, not oval or round (the page text says 'מעוגל', meaning rounded corners). Page does not say whether the waterfall is one piece or glued; assume solid per the page. Shipping to Israel, two options: cheapest = pick-up from the supplier warehouse by prior arrangement (cost not published); fastest reasonable = home delivery, 450 ILS fee shown on the page, area Hadera to Ashkelon to Modi'in only, lead time not published. Installer optional for a fee. Photo rights unclear (IDANA photos; written permission needed before use). Written supplier approval not obtained (rule C.0).
